steps.title: Look at the sentences.
steps.prompt: Which form do we use for more than one thing?
steps.why: there is + one thing. there are + two or more.
steps.html:
There's a cinema near the hotel.

There are some really nice restaurants.

There isn't a swimming pool.

There aren't any theatres.

steps.title: there is / there are
steps.html:
One thingMore than one
PositiveThere's a cinema.There are some restaurants.
NegativeThere isn't a pool.There aren't any theatres.
QuestionIs there a chemist?Are there any museums?
Short answerYes, there is. / No, there isn't.Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.

Use there is / there are to say that something exists in a place.

The verb agrees with what comes after it, not with there.

Learners often say There are a cinema. One thing takes there is.

steps.title: some, any, a lot of
steps.html:
UseExample
somepositive sentencesThere are some nice restaurants.
anynegatives and questionsThere aren't any theatres. Are there any museums?
a lot of / lots ofa big numberThere are lots of underground buildings.

some and any both mean an amount you do not need to count.

In an offer or a request, some is also used in a question: Could you give me some directions?

steps.title: Look at the title: 'A town under the ground'.
steps.sub: Why do you think people live under the ground?

options.label: Because it is too hot above the ground

steps.title: A town under the ground
steps.html:
Ask people what a good neighbourhood needs and the answers are always the same. There is a shop near the house. There is a school. There are some quiet streets and a park. There aren't any problems at night.

Coober Pedy in Australia has all of that — but it is under the ground. In summer the town is 45 degrees, so people build their homes in the rock. There are underground houses, an underground church and even an underground hotel.

So what isn't there? There isn't a theatre, and there aren't many swimming pools, because it hardly ever rains. But there is a cinema, there are some good cheap restaurants, and there is a museum in an old opal mine. Not bad for a town in the desert.
